Ana Paula! Did you hear the rumor? People are saying that the dog park is going to close.
Really? Who told you that?
I overheard two women at the gate. One of them said that the city wanted to build a parking lot here.
That sounds like gossip. Yesterday I talked to Carol, the organizer. She told me that the park was only closing for two weeks.
Two weeks? Why?
She explained that they were going to fix the fence. And she said that the city would announce it on Monday.
So she denied the parking lot story?
Completely. She laughed. And she asked if you could help with the new fence. Can I pass on your number?

Hi everyone, it's Carol. I just got back from the neighborhood meeting, and I want to pass on the news before the rumors start. First, the man from the city said that the old fence was not safe, and that they would build a new one. That is why the park is closing for two weeks, not forever. Some neighbors complained that the dogs were too loud in the morning, so the city asked us to wait until eight o'clock before we open the gate. I think that is fair. And the good news: they asked if our volunteers could paint the new benches. I said that we would be happy to help. So, who is free next Saturday?

Hey Ana Paula, it's Mike. I just left the vet with Biscuit, and I wanted to tell you what she said, because you asked me last week. She said that he was very healthy, which is great, but she told me that he was a little too heavy. Too many treats, I think. She told me to give him less food and more walks. She also asked if he was sleeping well, and I said that he slept better than me. Anyway, more walks means I need company. Do you want to walk the dogs together on Saturday morning? Call me back.

Did you hear the rumor about the dog park? Mike said that the park was going to close. Then I talked to Carol, the organizer. She told me that it was only closing for two weeks. She explained that they were going to fix the fence. So it was just a rumor.
